svg.desc: диагностика для специфического переключателя режимов ДИСТ-АВТОМАТ

rt:param.name: Obj_Type_Nr
rt:param.comment: Номер схемы сигналов из конф. файла от 1 до 3

rt:var.name: STrig
rt:var.comment: наш вывод в ремонт - запрет управления

rt:var.name: More_signals
rt:var.comment: Есть ещё сигналы, найденные по маске

rt:var.name: Mask
rt:var.comment: Маска поиска дополнительных сигналов, сконструированная по гибкому правилу с учётом наличия точек

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub HighlightMessage(ByVal TxtObj As RtSvgObj, ByVal pv As PlsPVBin, ByVal mask As UShort, ByVal HighlightColor As Int) If (pv == Nothing) || (mask == 0) Then TxtObj.visibility = "hidden" Else TxtObj.visibility = "visible" If pv.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then TxtObj.fill = 0xa0a0a0 TxtObj.font_size = 11 TxtObj.font_weight = "normal" TxtObj.text_decoration = "password" ElseIf (pv.Value & mask) != 0 Then TxtObj.text_decoration = "none" TxtObj.fill = HighlightColor TxtObj.font_size = 13 TxtObj.font_weight = "bold" Else TxtObj.text_decoration = "none" TxtObj.fill = 0xa0a0a0 TxtObj.font_size = 11 TxtObj.font_weight = "normal" End If End If End Sub

Sub HighlightMessageSimple(ByVal TxtObj As RtSvgObj, ByVal Highlight As Boolean, ByVal HighlightColor As Int) If Highlight Then TxtObj.fill = HighlightColor TxtObj.font_size = 13 TxtObj.font_weight = "bold" Else TxtObj.fill = 0xa0a0a0 TxtObj.font_size = 11 TxtObj.font_weight = "normal" End If End Sub

Sub A_diag() HighlightMessage(A, pv_A, mask_A, 0) If Is_NARY Then HighlightMessage(H, pv_A, mask_H, 0) HighlightMessage(A_MISMATCH, pv_A, mask_A_MISMATCH, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(H_MISMATCH, pv_A, mask_H_MISMATCH, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(FAIL, pv_A, mask_FAIL, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(FAIL_BLINK, pv_A, mask_FAIL_BLINK, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(INVALID, pv_A, mask_INVALID, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(UNDEFINED, pv_A, mask_UNDEFINED, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(SELECTED, pv_A, mask_SELECTED, 0) End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event:
Dim TmpName As String If Obj_Type_Nr < 1 Then Obj_Type_Nr = 1 ElseIf Obj_Type_Nr > 3 Then Obj_Type_Nr = 3 End If SchemeNr = "MOD" + CStr(Obj_Type_Nr) TopicID = "ObjectRules_" + SchemeNr Delimiter = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_DELIMITER")) Is_NARY = CBool(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_USE_SINGLE_NARY")) 'чтобы не задействовать лишние переменные If Is_NARY Then //это один NARY pv_A = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_AUTO"))) mask_A = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_AUTO")) mask_H = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_DIST")) mask_A_MISMATCH = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_AUTO_MISMATCH")) mask_H_MISMATCH = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_DIST_MISMATCH")) mask_FAIL = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_FAIL")) mask_FAIL_BLINK = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_FAIL_BLINK")) mask_INVALID = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_INVALID")) mask_UNDEFINED = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_UNDEFINED")) mask_SELECTED = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_SELECTED")) Else TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_AUTO")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_A = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_DIST")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_H = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_AUTO_MISMATCH")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_A_MISMATCH = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_DIST_MISMATCH")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_H_MISMATCH = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_FAIL")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_FAIL = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_FAIL_BLINK")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_FAIL_BLINK = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_INVALID")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_INVALID = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_UNDEFINED")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_UNDEFINED = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_SELECTED")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_SELECTED = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If If CBool(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_APPLY_MASK")) Then If pv_A != Nothing Then mask_A = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_AUTO")) End If If pv_H != Nothing Then mask_H = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_DIST")) End If If pv_A_MISMATCH != Nothing Then mask_A_MISMATCH = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_AUTO_MISMATCH")) End If If pv_H_MISMATCH != Nothing Then mask_H_MISMATCH = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_DIST_MISMATCH")) End If If pv_FAIL != Nothing Then mask_FAIL = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_FAIL")) End If If pv_FAIL_BLINK != Nothing Then mask_FAIL_BLINK = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_FAIL_BLINK")) End If If pv_INVALID != Nothing Then mask_INVALID = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_INVALID")) End If If pv_UNDEFINED != Nothing Then mask_UNDEFINED = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_UNDEFINED")) End If If pv_SELECTED != Nothing Then mask_SELECTED = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_SELECTED")) End If End If End If //изначально всё пусть будет скрыто A.visibility = "hidden" H.visibility = "hidden" A_MISMATCH.visibility = "hidden" H_MISMATCH.visibility = "hidden" FAIL.visibility = "hidden" FAIL_BLINK.visibility = "hidden" INVALID.visibility = "hidden" UNDEFINED.visibility = "hidden" SELECTED.visibility = "hidden" TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_COMMAND")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_OU = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If If (pv_OU == nothing) Then No_OU = True ElseIf (pv_OU.PVCategories != 2) Then No_OU = True Else No_OU = False End If If No_OU Then NO_OU.title = "Переменная " + KKS + Delimiter + TmpName + " не найдена или ее тип не Out" End If
TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_AUX_SIGNAL_MASK")) If Left(TmpName, 1) == "." Then 'если первый символ = точка, значит задана маска с точками Mask = PRJSPEC.BuildFinalMask(KKS, TmpName) Else 'иначе - маской является расширение после разделителя Mask = KKS + Delimiter + TmpName End If Dim selBINs(100) As Int Dim selANAs(100) As Int Dim actualANAs As Int Dim actualBINs As Int More_signals = PRJSPEC.GET_Selection(Mask, actualANAs, actualBINs, selANAs, selBINs)
